name: luna-worker-planner
description: Plan and govern projects while luna_worker maintains a project file tree and per-file explanations for reuse.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, and critically evaluate results.
interface.longDescription: Use this conversation as the project planner and controller. For repository code work, luna_worker keeps only a compact file tree and deduplicated per-file explanations in .luna-worker-context.md. Later self-contained workers read it first, while the planner critically reviews their final reports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Luna Worker Planner to have luna_worker maintain a project file tree and per-file explanations, require later workers to read them first, and critically review worker reports.
